pages.text: The warrior code is what makes a Clan cat different from a rogue. It is not a cage, young one. It is a path we walk together.
pages.title: The Warrior Code

pages.text: $(li)Defend your Clan, even with your life.$(li)Never hunt on another Clan's land.$(li)Elders, queens and kits are fed first.$(li)Respect your leader's word.$(li)Honor the full-moon truce at Gatherings.$(li)A true warrior does not need to kill to win a fight.

Those are my own words, not a list to learn by heart. When you are unsure what is right, ask yourself: would this keep my Clan safe and strong? $(br2)If the answer is yes, StarClan will walk beside you.
